capabilities: Import a shared SourceLayer Map as a new note
Preserve YouTube timestamp links from the shared selection
Write each import to the vault's SourceLayer folder
Re-import without overwriting earlier imported notes
extras: The link token is sent to the SourceLayer sharing service to fetch the content; the link must still be active at import time. No SourceLayer account is needed to import.
problem: Content shared from SourceLayer lives outside the vault, with no way to bring a shared map or selection into Obsidian as a note.

relations.evidence: In SourceLayer, choose Shareable link in the export menu and create a link

summary: Imports a shared SourceLayer Map or selection into a new Markdown note, keeping YouTube timestamp links when the selection includes them.
